description: Located in the jungles of Sangem, this waterfall is amongst the least visited one. It is close to the road and requires little walking to the waterfall. The waterfall is seasonal. It forms a pond at the foot of a waterfall and you can swim there. The nearest locality is Dudal and it is 66 kms from Panjim and 30 kms from Margao.
